lead: Shashi Kapoor was an Indian film director, born on 18 March 1938 in Kolkata.
He died on 4 December 2017 in Mumbai at the age of 79.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor and Padma Bhushan.
Below you will find a verified overview of Shashi Kapoor: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Shashi Kapoor — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shashi Kapoor was born on 18 March 1938 in Kolkata, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Prithviraj Kapoor and his mother, Ramsarni Kapoor. He is a sibling of Raj Kapoor and Shammi Kapoor.
His listed education includes Don Bosco High School.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi and English.
